name: Kube Panel
description: Inspect Kubernetes beside your code: browse pods and deployments, search and filter container logs, expand JSON log fields, and inspect events and highlighted YAML. Choose a context and namespace, optionally refresh logs every three seconds, or open a read-only k9s terminal; uses your local kubectl credentials and never changes your kubeconfig context.

cover.alt: Kube Panel's workload browser and log inspector, showing timestamps, log levels, search, and refresh controls with synthetic sample data.
